text: Recently, a new protein scoring system-the digestible indispensable amino acid score (DIAAS)-has been advocated as a superior approach to assessing protein quality. DIAAS is based on digestibility of protein in the ileum, which is believed to provide greater accuracy than current measures (108). Although DIAAS shows promise as replacement for PDCAAS and BV, many protein sources have yet to be examined using this method (108), thus compromising its practicality.
book: Science and Development of Muscle Hypertrophy
